entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You're here again, boy?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Don't blame me if you get eaten alive,[n]okay?
entries.uk: Не скаржся потім, якщо тебе з'їдять[n]живцем, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You sure come here a lot...
entries.uk: Ти й справді часто сюди заходиш...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: I don't really mind it, but keep yourself[n]in check, okay?
entries.uk: Я не проти, але знай міру,[n]гаразд?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Sorry, boy. Ichiko-chan isn't here today.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Or are you here to see me instead?
entries.uk: Чи, може, ти прийшов до мене?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Sorry, Ichiko-chan isn't here today.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: ...What brings you here at a time like this?
entries.uk: ...Що привело тебе сюди в таку пору?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Hm? What are you do—Oh!
entries.uk: Гм? Що ти тут ро... О!

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Are you here for the part-time job?
That's right.
No way.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, that's a relief! We were getting[n]desperate for help.
entries.uk: О, яке полегшення! Нам відчайдушно[n]бракувало рук.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Lies. It's written all over your face,[n]you know?
entries.uk: Брешеш. Це ж у тебе на обличчі[n]написано, знаєш?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: So, you here today to do a little[n]part-time work?
Lemme at it.
Maybe later.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Then let's get you started right away, hmm?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Aw, what a bummer. I'll ask you again[n]some other time...
entries.uk: Ой, як шкода. Спитаю тебе[n]іншим разом...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We have a target we haven't identified yet,[n]right? Maybe you can gather some more[n]info while you're working?
entries.uk: У нас є ціль, яку ми ще не встановили,[n]так? Може, позбираєш інформацію,[n]поки працюватимеш?

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Welcome, welcome!

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: ...How old are ya, boy?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Sorry, Lala-chan. He's with me.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Ooh, you picked up a real young one[n]this time... Just don't let a minor drink[n]alcohol, okay?
entries.uk: О, цього разу ти підчепила зовсім[n]молоденького... Тільки не дай малому[n]пити алкоголь, гаразд?
